summary: the text-literal escape `\r` decodes to a carriage return (13)
instruction: Change request for the A0 front end (lexer and parser): in a `text "..."` literal the escape `\r` must decode to a carriage return, byte 13, next to the existing `\n` (10) and `\t` (9). Any other escaped byte still stands for itself.
